policy_metadata.policy_title: Laboratory – Testing of Homocysteine Metabolism-Related Conditions

sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • Total homocysteine testing (CPT code 83090*) in plasma IS REIMBURSABLE in patients with homocystinuria or vitamin B12 deficiency.
